Class MoleculeRenderOptions

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.api.client.MoleculeRenderOptions
public final class MoleculeRenderOptions extends Object
Settings for one draw: camera angles, zoom, background, colors, and atom/bond sizes.

These settings do not change the molecule's stored geometry or global preferences. Positions use GUI pixels and angles use degrees. Rotation speed defaults to zero, so the view stays still unless you choose a speed and pass elapsed time to the drawing call.
